app.title: RAGDom Library
app.subtitle: The digital platform for scientific curricula

hero.title: The central platform for curricula and textbooks
hero.desc: Portable SQLite databases with hybrid search (BM25 + vector) to explore the entire scientific corpus.
hero.search_placeholder: Search the whole curriculum: numbers, symmetry, angles, exercises...

library.no_document_selected: Select a document to view its content
library.no_exercises_typed: No exercise detected by automatic typing in this database. The extracted content is fully available in the Courses tab.
library.media_empty: No content available for this media.
library.no_evaluations_typed: No assessment subject detected by automatic typing in this database.

ask.no_context: There is not enough context in the database to answer this question. No information will be fabricated.

automation.title: RAGDom Automation Hub
automation.engine_fallback: Warning: FTS5 BM25 degraded mode active (sqlite-vec not loaded). Vector semantic search is disabled; only FTS5 full-text search is active.
automation.force_strict_hint: If enabled, sqlite-vec failure blocks ingestion instead of allowing the FTS5 fallback.
automation.first_use_msg: No database yet — drop a PDF into the Sources card then launch ingestion: the database will be created automatically.

tabs.ingestion_sub: Launch, re-run or stop the pipeline and manage your sources (tree, folders, upload).
tabs.monitoring_sub: Real-time monitoring: pipeline steps, live console (SSE) and queue state.
tabs.contents_sub: Explore and edit ingested data: database → document → chapter/page → chunks, with scoped re-run and purge.
tabs.documents_sub: Documents ingested per database, scoped purge and quarantine re-runs.
tabs.providers_sub: Configure your providers, API keys and models detected per key.
tabs.settings_sub: Vector engine, system thresholds and advanced workshop settings.

contents.reprocess_started: Re-run started — follow progress in the Monitoring tab.
contents.purge_type_ok: Type OK to confirm the purge

purge.title: Scoped purge
purge.type_db_name: Retype the exact database name to confirm

settings.vec_threshold_hint: Controls the strictness of vector result filtering (anti-hallucination).
settings.bm25_threshold_hint: Controls the minimum accepted full-text score.

sources.title: Sources
sources.drop_hint: Drop PDFs here or click to upload
sources.folder_name_invalid: Invalid folder name (letters, digits, space, _ - . only).
sources.confirm_delete_file: Delete this source file? This action is irreversible.
sources.db_naming_hint: The database name derives from the path: /sources/Maths/TestAPI/x.pdf → Maths_TestAPI.sqlite.

onboarding.title: No databases yet
onboarding.step1_desc: Use the source manager in the Automation Hub to upload your textbooks.
onboarding.step2_desc: Run the pipeline to index pages and extract chunks and artifacts.
onboarding.step3_desc: Open the library to search, read, and chat with your content.

connection.title: RAGDom backend not started
connection.desc: Could not reach the backend. Make sure the server is running then retry.

footer.line1: RAGDom Library — Local Scientific Digital Library

auth.login_subtitle: Access to the RAGDom administration workspace.
auth.setup_subtitle: First launch: set the administrator credentials.
auth.username_hint: 3-64 characters: letters, digits, _ - . — no spaces or accents
auth.init_token_hint: The server requires an initialization token (RAGDOM_AUTH_TOKEN). Enter it to create the account.
auth.password_too_short: The password must contain at least 8 characters.

providers.title: LLM Providers
providers.note: A key = an access secret · the provider is used in priority order when Enabled · the model is detected live at the provider.
providers.no_keys: No key registered for this provider.
providers.model_provider_default_hint: Fallback used when a key has no model of its own.

launcher.title: Pipeline launcher
launcher.note: Start an ingestion from the sources tree or re-run an already-indexed scope.
launcher.pick_source: Pick the target in the sources tree
launcher.folder_mode_hint: Folder selected: every PDF in the folder will be queued (folder mode).
launcher.reprocess_warning: Purges the scope then fully re-ingests it (all layers).
launcher.all_layers_note: Re-running replays ALL layers over the scope (running a single isolated layer is not provided by the engine contract — execution unit: the page).
